decision.article_title: China to lower VAT export rebate on new energy vehicles - Reuters
decision.reason: The official Chinese State Tax Administration Ministry of Finance Notice 2026 No.29 unequivocally drops NEV VAT export rebate from 13% to 9% effective 1 April 2027, export customs declaration date determines applicability; manual date/HS/price-margin comparison qualifies as preliminary regulatory delta idea.

opportunities.idea_name: China NEV Export VAT Rebate Impact Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Calculate policy-versioned NEV export rebate differential and shipment margin implications before the official April 2027 rate change
opportunities.target_customer: Chinese EV exporters, dealers and finance/logistics tax teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manually imported shipment/customs date, vehicle category/HS list and tax base → effective rate 13%/9% → rebate and gross margin delta → scenario approval and document export
opportunities.why_now: Official Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration notice No29 issued 12 Oct 2026: NEV VAT rebate 13%→9% from 1 April 2027, based on customs declaration export date
opportunities.before_state: Export price contracts and deliveries planned without reflecting changed rebate in customs-date margin assumptions
opportunities.after_state: Traceable future-date rebate scenarios with product-list applicability and finance signoff; does not file taxes or access government APIs
